issues.display_title: Issue #4256: feat(tour): Integrate Virtual Tour Schedule API with Modal Logic
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Integrate the Virtual Tour Schedule modal (Schedule.jsx) on the Hosted Virtual Tour card with the backend API to fetch and persist activation/deactivation schedules.

Related UI/Slicing Task: #4255 (design/schedule-modal-logic)
Related Backend Issues: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1847, GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1849, GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1850

Scope & Target Files

  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Hosted/HostedTour/Components/Overlay/HostedOverlay.jsx
  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Hosted/HostedTour/Components/Schedule.jsx

Specification & Integration Details

1. Props Passing in HostedOverlay.jsx

Pass mid and tour_key to <Schedule />:

<Schedule mid={mid} tourKey={tour_key} />

2. Fetch Existing Schedule on Modal Open

When the schedule modal opens, retrieve existing schedule timestamps:

  • Endpoint: GET /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}
  • Response Format: 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "tour_key": "xxx",
    "moderation_id": 12345,
    "foverlay": {
      "is_active": true,
      "activate_at": "2026-09-15 09:00:00",
      "deactivate_at": "2026-09-20 18:00:00"
    },
    "goverlay": { ... }
  }
}
  • State Hydration:
    • Parse foverlay.activate_at and foverlay.deactivate_at into @internationalized/date objects.
    • Pre-fill the DatePicker values if timestamps exist; leave null if empty.

3. Date Validation Rules

  • Minimum Date: Neither activateOn nor deactivateOn can be selected in the past (minValue={now(getLocalTimeZone())}).
  • Range Ordering: deactivateOn must be strictly later than activateOn (deactivateOn.compare(activateOn) > 0).
  • Validation Feedback:
    • If deactivateOn <= activateOn, set isInvalid={true} on the Deactivate DatePicker with an inline error message (t_deactivate_on.t_error).
    • Disable the Save button if the range is invalid (isRangeInvalid).
    • Allow saving if only one of the dates is set (e.g. only activateOn or only deactivateOn).
    • Both dates empty: treated as a cancel/clear schedule action.

4. Save Schedule (handleSave)

Replace the client-side setTimeout mock in Schedule.jsx (ref: #4255) with the real API call:

  • Endpoint: POST /virtualtours/schedule
  • Method: POST
  • Payload: 
    {
  "moderation_id": mid,
  "tour_key": tour_key,
  "overlay_type": "hosted",
  "schedule_activate_at": "2026-09-15 09:00:00",
  "schedule_deactivate_at": "2026-09-20 18:00:00"
}
  • Format @internationalized/date values to standard server datetime format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss).
  • If user clears both fields, send DELETE /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}&overlay_type=hosted or pass null values to remove the schedule.

5. UI & Error Handling

  • Show spinner/skeleton while fetching existing schedule on modal open.
  • Maintain isLoading={saving} on the Save button during request.
  • Display error toast if API returns an error.
  • Display success toast upon successful save and close the modal.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Builds on top of UI slicing from #4255.
  • <Schedule /> receives mid and tourKey props from HostedOverlay.jsx.
  • Opening modal retrieves existing schedule timestamps and populates the DatePickers.
  • Date Validation:
    • Blocks selecting dates in the past.
    • Enforces deactivateOn strictly greater than activateOn.
    • Shows inline error message and disables Save button on invalid range.
    • Supports setting only activateOn, only deactivateOn, or both.
  • Saving sends POST /virtualtours/schedule with formatted timestamps and overlay_type: "hosted".
  • Handles clearing/resetting schedule when fields are emptied.
  • Loading and error states handled with standard GoThru toasts and spinner.
  • Tier check for Pro/Agency remains active.

Result

  • Branch: feat/4254-schedule-button-modal
  • API Integration:
    • GET /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}: Hydrates existing schedule data.
    • POST /virtualtours/schedule: Persists formatted schedule timestamps with local ⇄ UTC conversion.
    • DELETE /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}&overlay_type=hosted: Clears active schedules.
  • UX & DatePicker Polish:
    • Automatically converts between local browser timezone and server UTC (09:00 WIB local -> 02:00 UTC server).
    • Smart default time on date selection (defaults to next valid future time if today is picked, or 00:00:00 for future dates).
    • Real-time validation preventing past time selection with inline error message and disabled Save button.
    • Prevented popover flickering and clipping inside modal (popoverProps & classNamesModal).
  • Tests: 100% passing across all 26 automated unit tests (Schedule.test.jsx).

issues.display_title: Issue #4249: feat(copilot): Integrate New RAG Backend into Copilot Chat Widget
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1834, GoThruMedia/gothru-rag#16, GoThruMedia/frontend-rag-system

Summary

Migrate and integrate the new RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) copilot backend into the GoThru Dashboard chat widget.

Previously, the chat widget connected to the legacy session-based gpt backend (https://gpt.gothru.co). With the introduction of the gothru-rag microservice and its authenticated proxy endpoint in GoThru-API-New (POST /copilot/chat, PR #1834), the chat widget assets and dashboard integration need to be updated to consume the new RAG service with conversational context history and verified knowledge source references.

Technical Context & Scope

1. Update Static Widget Bundle (public/scripts/widget.js, public/styles/widget.css)

  • Synchronize and update the prebuilt distribution assets from GoThruMedia/frontend-rag-system (branch feat/gothru-rag-integration):
    • Point API communication to the GoThru API Copilot proxy endpoint (/copilot/chat).
    • Adapt chat request payload to include prompt message and conversation history context ({ message, context: { history }, provider }).
    • Render RAG response structure including markdown answer and referenced knowledge sources.
    • Apply updated Tailwind CSS v4 styling rules in public/styles/widget.css.

2. Cache Busting & Asset Loading (src/components/layouts/Layout.jsx, public/index.html)

  • Update version query parameters on script and stylesheet links to prevent client-side browser caching:
    • In Layout.jsx: increment /scripts/widget.js?t=v5 to /scripts/widget.js?t=v6.
    • In public/index.html: increment %PUBLIC_URL%/styles/widget.css?t=v4 to %PUBLIC_URL%/styles/widget.css?t=v6.

3. Container & Auth Handshake (#chat-container)

  • Ensure #chat-container attributes are correctly supplied:
    • data-token: authenticated user token stripped of gt. prefix when needed.
    • data-theme: current theme preference (dark/light) synchronized with dashboard state.
    • data-vertical: responsive vertical offset (140px on mobile, 80px on desktop).

4. Access Control Verification (src/hooks/useAuth.jsx)

  • Ensure the canAccessChatAI permission flag correctly gates widget script injection and DOM container rendering based on user eligibility.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Production build of the RAG widget bundle (widget.js and widget.css) is placed in public/.
  • Cache-busting version query parameters in Layout.jsx and public/index.html are incremented.
  • Chat widget successfully initializes and opens for authorized users (canAccessChatAI === true).
  • Widget sends chat requests to the new Copilot proxy (POST /copilot/chat) with auth token and conversation context.
  • AI responses with markdown formatting and referenced knowledge sources are displayed correctly.
  • Theme switching (dark/light) reflects properly inside the chat widget.
  • No regressions or console errors in the main layout lifecycle.

issues.display_title: Issue #4247: feat(support): Integrate Copilot Action Document Upload (Single & Batch) in /support/gothru-document
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1844, #4242

Summary

Add an action document upload modal on /support/gothru-document allowing administrators to upload single or multiple Markdown (.md) knowledge documents simultaneously to the GoThru Copilot RAG service via POST /copilot/admin/actions/batch.

Technical Context & Scope

1. Upload Modal Component (src/components/organism/Support/GothruDocument/UploadDocumentsModal.jsx)

  • Create a NextUI CustomModal with an interactive drag-and-drop file dropzone:
    • Restricted to Markdown files (.md).
    • Allows single and multiple file selection.
    • Lists selected files with name, file size, and remove button prior to submission.
    • Checkbox for overwrite (default: true).
  • Form submission:
    • Appends selected files to FormData under the field actions[].
    • Dispatches to internal API: POST /copilot/admin/actions/batch (useBaseUrl: true).
  • Status & Feedback:
    • Disables modal actions and shows loading spinner on the submit button while uploading.
    • On success: closes modal, displays toast summary of uploaded documents, and triggers onSuccess() to reload the actions table.
    • On failure: displays error toast detailing failed files or validation issues.

2. Table Header Integration (src/pages/Support/GoThruDocument/GoThruDocument.jsx)

  • Add an "Upload Document" button in the table header card (CardHeader) next to the search bar.
  • Uses legacy button styling:
    • Variant: solid, Color: primary, StartContent: <i className="fa-solid fa-cloud-arrow-up" />.

3. Tests

  • Add unit test suite in UploadDocumentsModal.test.jsx:
    • Verify modal opens on trigger button click.
    • Verify .md file selection and validation.
    • Verify FormData construction and API call to /copilot/admin/actions/batch.
    • Verify success callback and list reload trigger.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Table header includes "Upload Document" button that opens the upload modal.
  • Dropzone accepts .md files via file picker or drag-and-drop.
  • Supports single and multi-file batch upload to POST /copilot/admin/actions/batch.
  • Displays loading state during upload.
  • Refreshes document table automatically upon successful upload.
  • All unit tests pass with 100% green and ESLint is clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #4246: feat(support): Integrate Copilot Knowledge Action Deletion in /support/gothru-document
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1843, #4242

Summary

Integrate the action document deletion flow in DeleteDocuments.jsx using the internal proxy endpoint DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug} from GoThru-API-New.

Previously, DeleteDocuments.jsx targeted the legacy endpoint (https://gpt.gothru.co/documents/${id}) using legacy token stripping. This task migrates the deletion modal and trigger to invoke the new Copilot admin delete API with proper auth headers, error handling, and list refresh.

Technical Context & Scope

1. Endpoint & Hook Migration (src/components/organism/Support/GothruDocument/DeleteDocuments.jsx)

  • Replace legacy URL https://gpt.gothru.co/documents/${id} with internal API:
    • Route: DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug}
    • Auth: Automatically injected gt.<token> via useBaseUrl: true.
  • Utilize dynamic path parameter: pathParams: { slug }.
  • Extract action slug safely from document.slug, document.id, or document.file_name (stripping .md extension).

2. Confirmation Modal & UX

  • Retain the standard NextUI confirmation modal (CustomModal) displaying the document title or slug.
  • Show button loading state (isLoading={isDeleting}) while deletion is in progress.
  • On success:
    • Close the modal.
    • Display success toast notification.
    • Trigger onSuccess() callback to refresh the document list table in GoThruDocument.jsx.
  • On error:
    • Display error toast with upstream failure message.

3. Tests

  • Add unit test suite in DeleteDocuments.test.jsx:
    • Verify modal opens upon clicking Delete button.
    • Verify DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug} is dispatched with correct path parameters.
    • Verify success toast and onSuccess callback are invoked upon completion.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Delete action dispatches DELETE /copilot/admin/actions/{slug} via internal API gateway.
  • Modal displays confirmation prompt with the target document title.
  • Deletion triggers list refresh and success toast upon successful response.
  • Error response from server displays error toast gracefully.
  • All unit tests pass with 100% green and ESLint is clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #4245: feat(support): Integrate Copilot Knowledge Action Detail View in /support/gothru-document/:id
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1843, #4242

Summary

Integrate the action document detail view in DocumentEditor.jsx (/support/gothru-document/:id) using the internal proxy endpoint GET /copilot/admin/actions/{id} from GoThru-API-New.

Previously, /support/gothru-document/:id was connected to the legacy service (https://gpt.gothru.co/documents/${id}) with full editor and ChromaDB polling logic. This task migrates the detail page to a clean, read-only modern blog / article layout that renders Markdown content natively without external editor plugins.

Technical Context & Scope

1. API Integration (src/pages/Support/GoThruDocument/DocumentEditor.jsx)

  • Replace legacy endpoint https://gpt.gothru.co/documents/${id} with internal API:
    • Route: GET /copilot/admin/actions/{id}
    • Auth: Automatically injected gt.<token> via useBaseUrl: true.
  • Extract action payload from res.data.action (supporting title, file_name, content, updated_at, and created_at).
  • Eliminate legacy create/edit forms, ChromaDB checking polling, and user notification checkboxes in view mode.

2. Native Lightweight Markdown Viewer (src/pages/Support/GoThruDocument/MarkdownViewer.jsx)

  • Build a lightweight native Markdown parser and renderer without external editor plugins (@uiw/react-md-editor).
  • Support essential documentation syntax:
    • Headings (h1 through h6) with clean vertical rhythm.
    • Formatted lists (ul, ol).
    • Code blocks with language badge and one-click copy button.
    • Inline formatting: bold, italic, inline code pill, and external links with icon.
    • Blockquotes with primary border accent.
    • Markdown table rendering with alternating rows.
  • Automatically strip leading # H1 from the markdown body to avoid duplicate title headers.

3. Modern Blog Style & Legacy Alignment

  • Consistent with existing GoThru Dashboard design tokens:
    • Container: bg-white dark:bg-zinc-700, borders dark:border-zinc-600, text text-default-900 dark:text-white.
    • PageLayout: Standard support title (GPT GoThru Documents), breadcrumb navigation (Support > GPT GoThru Documents > [Document Name]), and back button.
  • Blog Article Hero:
    • Prominent article title (h1).
    • Metadata strip displaying file name badge (.md), updated date, and estimated reading time.
    • Quick action to copy raw Markdown to clipboard.

4. Tests

  • Unit test suite in DocumentEditor.test.jsx verifying detail fetching, title formatting, back navigation, and leading H1 deduplication.
  • Unit test suite in MarkdownViewer.test.jsx verifying markdown elements and inline rendering.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Detail page fetches action document from GET /copilot/admin/actions/{id} via internal API gateway.
  • Displays document title, file name, updated timestamp, and reading time in article hero.
  • Markdown content is parsed and rendered cleanly without third-party editor plugins.
  • Leading H1 in markdown content is stripped to eliminate duplicate titles.
  • Back button navigates back to /support/gothru-document.
  • Copy Markdown button copies raw content to clipboard.
  • All unit tests pass with 100% green and ESLint is clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #4242: feat(support): Integrate Copilot Knowledge Actions List in /support/gothru-document
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1843, GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1844

Summary

Migrate /support/gothru-document from the legacy external service (https://gpt.gothru.co) to the internal GoThru API Copilot endpoint (GET /copilot/admin/actions).

Currently, GoThruDocument.jsx calls legacy GPT endpoints that are being deprecated. This task covers updating the action documents table view to fetch from the new proxy endpoint in GoThru-API-New, mapping the response attributes (title, file_name, timestamps), and supporting client-side filtering and pagination.

Technical Context & Scope

1. Endpoint & Hook Migration (src/pages/Support/GoThruDocument/GoThruDocument.jsx)

  • Replace the legacy URL https://gpt.gothru.co/documents/search with the new internal API endpoint:
    • Route: /copilot/admin/actions
    • Enable useBaseUrl: true (targets REACT_APP_BASE_URL with standard gt.<token> authentication).
  • Handle the response envelope:
    • Extract array from res.data.actions (or res.actions).

2. Table Column & Data Mapping

  • Map the RAG action file schema to the NextUI table:
    • Title: item.title (fallback to item.file_name).
    • Slug / File Name: item.file_name.
    • Created Date: customFormatDate(item.created_at).
    • Updated Date: customFormatDate(item.updated_at).
  • Replace the legacy created_by column with File Name / Slug (item.file_name).
  • Update the View action button to navigate using item.file_name / item.slug instead of numeric item.id.

3. Client-Side Search & Pagination

  • Since GET /copilot/admin/actions returns all knowledge action files in a single payload, implement fast client-side filtering:
    • Filter actions by title and file_name matching the search keyword.
    • Slice the filtered list according to the active page and limit per page (10, 20, 30).
    • Update pagination total pages dynamically based on filtered results.

4. Localization (src/locales/en.json)

  • Adjust table header translation keys under t_gothru_document if needed (e.g. rename or add t_file_name / t_slug).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Table fetches knowledge action documents from GET /copilot/admin/actions via internal API gateway.
  • Admin permission check remains enforced (profile.user_type === '2').
  • Renders list of actions with title, file_name, created_at, and updated_at.
  • Search input filters action items in real-time by title and filename.
  • Client-side pagination works seamlessly when switching pages or items-per-page.
  • Clicking "View" button directs to /support/gothru-document/:slug with valid file identifier.
  • Loading and empty state UI components render correctly.

issues.display_title: Issue #4260: [Integration] Photographer Services: replace localStorage mock with real Professional-Services API
issues.main_description_html:
Context

The Photographer "Services" page on design/photographer-professional-services is currently a UI-only slice backed by localStorage (see src/pages/Photographer/hooks/usePhotographerServices.jsx, which explicitly marks MOCK DATA and has a TODO(integration) to swap it for a real API). This task wires it to the real backend through the new proxy.

Current model (dashboard)

Each row: { id, name, url, icon } — ordered by array position. Save is row-level (handleSaveRow writes one row to localStorage); delete also row-level.

Target upstream API (Go gothru-maps-backend-go, proxied via GoThru API New)

  • GET /v1/photographers/{gothruUserId}/professional-services
    200 → { data: { professionalServices: [ {id:int, icon, name, link, order:int} ] } }
    404 → { data: { error: "Photographer not found" } }
  • PUT /v1/photographers/{gothruUserId}/professional-services
    Body → { services: [ {icon, name, link} ] } (full replace of the whole array)
    200 → { data: { message: "...", professionalServices: [...] } }
    400 on validation/role (≤20 items; name required ≤150; icon optional ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$; link optional absolute http(s) ≤2048; role must be image_processing).

Mapping

Dashboard API Note
name name same
url link rename on read/write
icon icon lucide names already match regex
id (string svc-…) id (int) use API id; track new rows locally before save
position order derived from array index on save

Requirements

  1. Replace loadStoredServices / saveStoredServices (localStorage) with real API calls through the proxy:
    • Load: GET → map items to {id, name, url: link, icon}.
    • Persist: PUT with the full { services: [...] } replace semantics — rework handleSaveRow / handleDeleteRow so that save/delete edit the in-memory list, then send the whole array in one PUT (the upstream replace has no per-row endpoint).
  2. Map icon/name/link and derive order from array index.
  3. Handle loading and error states; relay upstream 404 (photographer not found) and 400 (validation/role) errors to the user via the existing toast pattern.
  4. Keep the icon picker and autocomplete catalog as-is.

Out of scope

  • No creation/modification of the upstream API — it already exists.
  • Backend/proxy tasks live on the API repo (GET proxy #1858, PUT proxy #1859 on GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New).

Acceptance criteria

  • Opening the page loads existing professional services from the API (not localStorage).
  • Saving/deleting an item sends a single PUT with the full services array and reflects the returned list.
  • id/order are respected; url maps to API link and back.
  • Upstream error (404 / 400) is surfaced gracefully.
  • localStorage mock code is removed.

Related

  • Feature branch: design/photographer-professional-services
  • Hook to change: src/pages/Photographer/hooks/usePhotographerServices.jsx
  • Upstream endpoints: gothru-maps-backend-go src/action/v1/photographers/professionalServices.go

Result

Implemented and verified in PR: #4261

Changes

  • API Integration: Replaced localStorage mock in src/pages/Photographer/hooks/usePhotographerServices.jsx with real endpoints:
    • GET /photographers/professional-services via useLazyFetch
    • PUT /photographers/professional-services via usePut (whole-array replace semantics)
  • Field & Contract Mapping:
    • Internal url maps to API link
    • Internal icon, name, and numeric id mapped
    • Order preserved via array order
  • Status Synchronization: Redux SET_PHOTOGRAPHER dispatches status 1 if photographer was approved (status 3) per upstream business rules.
  • UI Enhancements:
    • Added NextUI Spinner on PhotographerServices.jsx during initial fetch
    • Disabled Add button during loading
    • Wired isDeleting loading indicator into DeleteModal
